title: 第3章 好狗不挡道第4章 你敢对我拔剑
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;“什么？”
辰南浑身颤抖，眼中血丝攀爬，死死的盯着圣主。
三年前，紫薇圣地与黑暗魔教爆发了圣魔大战。
辰镇东作为紫薇圣地的三大强者之一，率众迎战。
那一战，打得天昏地暗，血染山河。
最终紫薇圣地在辰镇东的带领下，大获全胜。
然而就在大战结束，即将回归的时候。
辰镇东遭遇黑暗魔教的埋伏，壮烈牺牲，甚至连尸骨都找不到。
一直以来，辰南都以为是意外，但现在圣主却告诉他另有隐情？
“辰南，你父亲是我紫薇圣地的三大强者之一，普通的圣人根本不是他的对手。”
“而且当年他是独自离开大军，遭遇了黑暗魔教的伏击。”
“所以我怀疑，圣地内部，有黑暗魔教的奸细。”
“你若要重开辰家一脉，必然会被魔教奸细盯上。”
“我虽是圣主，但也不可能面面俱到，你所要面对的危险，可能比你想象的更加可怕。”
“你确定还要继续重开辰家一脉吗？”
圣主望着辰南，语气凝重。
大殿之中，气氛压抑得令人喘不过气来。
辰南眼中血红，一股滔天的真怒与杀意自心头涌起。
但他深吸一口气，将心中那翻涌的愤怒缓缓的压制了下来。
他知道，愤怒解决不了任何问题。
“杀父之仇，不共戴天。”
“我不仅要重开辰家一脉，还要揪出魔教奸细，替父报仇。”
“无论凶手是谁，我一定要让他血债血偿！”
辰南咬紧牙关，神色坚定。
恍惚间，圣主似乎看见了年轻时的辰镇东。
“既然你已经下定决心，那我便成全了你！”
“你先回去，我准备法旨，昭告圣地。”
圣主最终还是答应了。
“多谢圣主！”
辰南松了口气，躬身一拜。
“你父亲虽然不在了，但我一直把你当子侄看待。”
“以后若有什么麻烦，尽管来找我！”
“这是我的圣主令，见令如见我，还能操控部分的圣地大阵之力，你虽然能够修炼了，但毕竟实力低微，若遇到危险，可用此保命。”
圣主心头一软，许下了承诺。
随后他取出一块圣主令赠送给辰南。
圣主令不单单是身份的象征，而且还蕴含一丝圣主之力，可以操控一丝紫薇圣地的防护大阵，在这紫薇圣地内，有了这块圣主令，辰南的安全性大大增强。

read2(); "What?"
Chen Nan was trembling all over, his eyes were bloodshot, and he was staring at the Holy Lord.
Three years ago, a holy-demon war broke out between the Ziwei Holy Land and the Dark Demon Cult.
As one of the three powerful men in Ziwei Holy Land, Chen Zhendong led the crowd to fight.
In that battle, the sky was dark and the earth was dark, and the mountains and rivers were stained with blood.
In the end, Ziwei Holy Land won a great victory under the leadership of Chen Zhendong.
However, just when the war was over and he was about to return.
Chen Zhendong encountered an ambush from the Dark Demon Cult and died heroically. Not even his body could be found.
All along, Chen Nan thought it was an accident, but now the Holy Lord told him that there was another hidden secret?
"Chen Nan, your father is one of the three powerful men in our Ziwei Holy Land. Ordinary saints are no match for him."
"And when he left the army alone, he was ambushed by the Dark Demon Cult."
"So I suspect that there are spies from the Dark Demon Cult inside the Holy Land."
"If you want to reopen the Chen family, you will definitely be targeted by the devil's spies."
"Although I am the Holy Master, I cannot cover everything. The dangers you face may be more terrifying than you imagine."
"Are you sure you want to continue to reopen the Chen family lineage?"
The Holy Master looked at Chen Nan with a solemn tone.
The atmosphere in the main hall was so oppressive that it was breathless.
Chen Nan's eyes were blood red, and a surge of true anger and murderous intent surged from his heart.
But he took a deep breath and slowly suppressed the raging anger in his heart.
He knew that anger would not solve anything.
"The hatred for killing my father is irreconcilable."
"Not only do I want to reopen the Chen family, I also want to uncover the spies of the Demon Cult and avenge my father."
"No matter who the murderer is, I must make him pay with blood!"
Chen Nan gritted his teeth and looked determined.
In a daze, the Holy Lord seemed to see the young Chen Zhendong.
"Now that you have made up your mind, I will make it happen for you!"
"You go back first, and I will prepare the decree and announce it to the Holy Land."
The Holy Lord finally agreed.
"Thank you Holy Lord!"
Chen Nan breathed a sigh of relief and bowed.
"Although your father is no longer here, I always treat you as my nephew."
"If you have any trouble in the future, just come to me!"
"This is my Holy Lord's Order. If you see me, you can also control part of the power of the Holy Land Formation. Although you can practice, your strength is low after all. If you encounter danger, you can use this to save your life."
The Holy Master softened his heart and made a promise.
Then he took out a piece of the Holy Lord's Token and presented it to Chen Nan.
The Holy Lord's Token is not only a symbol of status, but also contains a hint of the Holy Lord's power, which can control a trace of the protective formation of the Ziwei Holy Land. In this Ziwei Holy Land, with this Holy Lord's Token, Chen Nan's security is greatly enhanced.
